notes: The VEL-9 System Atlas — an interactive survey of a fictional planetary system 12.4 light-years from Sol. Features four major interactive components: (1) Filterable planetary catalog with search, type/zone filters, and multi-column sorting; (2) Orbital timeline scrubber simulating 500 years of system evolution with play/pause, conjunction markers, habitable zone visualization, and real-time stats; (3) Annotated cross-section diagram of VEL-9 e with seven interactive hotspots revealing interior structure, atmosphere, magnetosphere, and surface data; (4) Side-by-side comparison slider with four visualization modes (structure, atmosphere, surface, orbital) and five preset pairings. Includes substantial original worldbuilding content (~4,000 words) with consistent editorial voice, honest epistemics labeling (Measured/Inferred/Speculative), procedural canvas animations (hero background, orbital simulation), full keyboard navigation, reduced-motion support, WCAG AA contrast, responsive design from 320px to 2560px+, and no external dependencies beyond Google Fonts. All visualizations rendered in Canvas/SVG via vanilla JS — no frameworks, build steps, or external APIs.
